info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程針對複合材料結構作力學分析，包括非均向材料、應力與應變、纖維受力變形、層板力學理論、材料測試實驗以及複合材料破壞現象
description.describe_eh: This course introduces the basic concepts in composite mechanics. The course contains anisotropic material, stress and strain, fiber deformation, lamination theory, composite testing experiment, and composite failure.

targets.describe_ch: 對複合材料之幾何型態有相當之瞭解。
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of the basic geometry of composite materials

targets.describe_ch: 使學生對複合材料之疊層力學有相當之瞭解。
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of the lamination theory of composite materials

targets.describe_ch: 具對同學及指導老師口頭報告其分析作品之能力
targets.describe_en: To be capable of making a fine presentation of their analysis works to their classmates and instructor

targets.describe_ch: 對複合材料力學之應用有相當之瞭解。
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of the application of composite materials

targets.describe_ch: 理解社會責任及環境永續發展使命感。
targets.describe_en: To comprehend community responsibility and the duty of environment continues forever to develop.
